row.title: Fleet drift issues close on a token-free probe (FLEET-PROBE-1)
row.body: Drift issues were filed without a probe line, so the issue loop could not close them although CITATION.cff already carried the license. fleet --probe COPY@REPO reads this repository from the working tree and any other repository through the fleet token, and an unreadable copy is not a pass. The three publication-files items now use it. Evidence: tests/foundation/test_fleet.py passes.

title: Fleet drift issues close on a token-free probe (FLEET-PROBE-1)
